system.description: Beginning, at 6th level, your chakra fueled fury boils over into a Frenzy. While you are in a Battle Trance you gain the benefits of all abilities marked as Level 6 within the Battle Trance state. Additionally, while in Battle Trance you gain immunity to the Charmed, Demoralized and Shaken conditions.

source.custom: Imported full source rules; contextual benefits require adjudication.
